scope: One change at a time on the three production Warlock requests against 2 to 5 copies of the boss (validation/2026-10-06-warlock-multi-target-census/bases): each Warlock spell cast from the top of the rotation, with the talent that grants it where one does, a multidot line for each dot spell and for the four main dots together, and each talent at its maximum or removed with Rain of Fire at two or more targets and Hellfire at four or more in the rotation, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.
generator: for N from 2 to 5, python3 tools/warlock_census.py --bases validation/2026-10-06-warlock-multi-target-census/bases/N-targets --output <scratch>/wcN; each variant <scratch>/wcN/NAME.json is compared as N-targets--NAME.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every request matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log.
